description: For customers using VAIO? with built-in infrared remote control function or optional IR Adapter, you will be able to use this application to control compatible home devices such as TV, set-top box, etc. For customers using optional IR Adapter, please update the device driver from VAIO Update. This infrared remote control app allows you to control various devices; particularly audiovisual devices. Registering a device is simple because the remote control codes for the audiovisual devices of major manufacturers are preset. A registered device can be controlled from your VAIO.
